business_drivers.problema: The telecom operator has a high monthly churn rate, negatively impacting recurring revenue (MRR) and increasing customer acquisition cost (CAC).
stakeholders: Customer Success (direct intervention with at-risk customers)
Data Team (model development, validation and maintenance)

acceptable_accuracy_tradeoffs.falsos_negativos: High risk: churning customers not identified by the model, resulting in direct loss of future revenue.
acceptable_accuracy_tradeoffs.falsos_positivos: Medium risk: non-churning customers treated as at-risk, generating unnecessary actions and increased costs.
acceptable_accuracy_tradeoffs.decisao: Prioritize high recall for the churn class.

data.tipo: Structured tabular data with demographic, contracted-services, behavioral and financial variables.
data.tamanho: Dataset with >= 5,000 records and >= 10 variables (scalable to millions in production).
data.velocidade: Near real-time inference via API, integrated with CRM systems.

infrastructure.desenvolvimento: Versioned environment with dependency management, experimentation and automated testing.
infrastructure.rastreamento: Use of MLflow for experiment, metrics and artifact tracking.
infrastructure.producao: Containerized pipeline with Docker, model exposed via REST API for inference.

goal.objetivo_ciencia_dados: Develop a churn classification model optimized to reach recall > 70%, precision > 60% and AUC > 80%.
goal.objetivo_tecnico: Implement a reproducible end-to-end pipeline with versioning, validation and continuous monitoring of metrics (recall, precision, AUC) in production.
goal.objetivo_cd_avancado: Apply cost-sensitive learning and threshold tuning to optimize the recall/precision trade-off, ensuring AUC > 80%.

model_type.principal: Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) neural network with PyTorch

intervention.acao: Predictions feed the CRM to trigger retention strategies for high-risk customers.

downstream.entrega: Model served via REST API (FastAPI) returning churn probability and classification.

monitoramento.descricao: Continuous monitoring with metrics and alerts

downstream.retraining: Periodic retraining (e.g., monthly) or triggered by performance degradation

premissas: Past behavior is predictive of future churn
perguntas_negocio: What is the current churn rate?
How much does losing a customer cost?
How many customers can we reach per month?
What is the ideal lead time?
